name: Sales Expansion
description: Companies scaling outbound or enterprise sales motions after product-market traction — hiring sellers, entering markets, and investing in GTM capacity.

attributes.label: Growing sales team
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find public evidence of a growing sales team: open AE/SDR/Account Executive/Sales Development roles on careers pages, news about sales hiring, or headcount growth in sales. Prefer primary sources from the last 18 months.
positiveSignals: Open AE or SDR job postings
Press about expanding the sales team

attributes.label: New market expansion
attributes.description: Geographic or segment expansion beyond a single core market.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find public evidence of new market expansion: new country/region launches, new offices, localization, multi-country pricing, or press about expanding into new geographies in the last 24 months.
positiveSignals: New region or country launch announcements
New office openings outside HQ market
negativeSignals: Explicit single-market-only positioning with no expansion plans

attributes.label: Recent funding
attributes.description: Recent venture or growth capital that funds GTM scale.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find funding rounds (Series A–E, growth equity, or similar) announced in roughly the last 24 months. Prefer primary sources naming round size, stage, and lead investor.
positiveSignals: Announced funding round in last ~24 months
Growth equity or late-stage raise for expansion
negativeSignals: Explicit bootstrapped-only with no institutional raise

attributes.label: B2B offering
attributes.description: Product sold primarily to businesses rather than pure B2C.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, determine whether the offering is sold B2B or B2B2C vs pure B2C. Look at pricing for teams, enterprise pages, business ICP language, and case studies.
negativeSignals: Pure consumer marketplace or B2C-only positioning

attributes.label: Clear sales organization
attributes.description: Named sales leadership and/or described sales motion.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find evidence of a sales organization: CRO, VP Sales, Head of Sales titles, sales methodology mentions, or enterprise sales pages.
positiveSignals: Enterprise sales page or sales methodology
negativeSignals: No sales function; pure self-serve with no sales team

attributes.label: Outbound / GTM motion
attributes.description: Outbound, SDR, partner, or sales-assisted GTM signals.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find evidence of outbound or assisted GTM: SDR motion, outbound case studies, partner/channel programs, or PLG + sales-assisted language.
negativeSignals: Explicit no-sales-calls / never talk to sales only

attributes.label: Tech/ops buyer signals
attributes.description: Surfaces aimed at technical or ops buyers (integrations, security, API).
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find technical buyer surfaces: integrations directory, security/trust page, API docs, or stack pages aimed at engineering/ops buyers.
negativeSignals: No technical buyer surface on the public site
